messages.subject: Robustness example in the manual
parts:
attack.vertex.degree <- rbindlist(lapply(g, function(x)robustness(x[[N]], type='vertex', measure='degree')))

I have been trying to use the code in the manual version 2.7 page 110, I tried to use an Igraph network of my own but then what is x and what is [[N]] 
I get an error "Error in is_igraph(g) : object 'N' not found"

Can you please explain how I can use this code with my own graphs, or list of graphs ?

messages.author: 28bb28f8fe8898a5
messages.subject: Re: Robustness example in the manual
parts:
I'm sorry I missed this post.

Are you a beginner in R? Please follow the User Guide in detail, and consider following R tutorials. That is, do not just skip ahead to that page and try to copy the code. I usually try to explain everything so that it is clear to non-experts, and if it is not in the User Guide then it might be in the function documentation.

"g" is the list of "igraph" objects.
"N" is an integer.
"x" is a variable to the anonymous function being performed in "lapply".
